protocols.name: QOTD (Quote of the Day)
protocols.what: Server sends a quote when you connect. No request needed. Just connect, get wisdom.
protocols.status: Almost extinct. A few public servers remain.
protocols.love_star_use: 愛星 truth server — connect, get a random truth. No HTTP overhead. Pure TCP.

protocols.name: Finger
protocols.what: Query a user's status on a remote machine. Returns their plan file (.plan), last login, etc.
protocols.status: Removed from most servers for security. But the protocol is beautiful — simple, human, social.
protocols.love_star_use: 愛星 hunter lookup — finger a user, see their level, XP, shadow army. Social protocol reborn.

protocols.name: Gopher
protocols.what: Text-based menu system. Before HTTP won. Hierarchical, no styling, pure content. Fast.
protocols.status: Gopher survived! Overbite, Floodgap, gopher.floodgap.com still serve. Community keeps it alive.
protocols.love_star_use: 愛星 truth menu — pure text, no JS, no CSS, no tracking. Browse truths via Gopher. No ads. No cookies.

protocols.name: Daytime (port 13)
protocols.what: Server sends human-readable date/time. Simple. No protocol. Just connect, get time.
protocols.status: Mostly replaced by NTP. But it's simpler and human-readable.
protocols.love_star_use: 愛星 heartbeat sync — connect, get the current truth tick number. Time IS truth count.

protocols.name: Echo (port 7)
protocols.what: Whatever you send, the server echoes back. The simplest protocol ever invented.
protocols.status: Used for testing. But also: a perfect truth mirror. Send a truth, it comes back confirmed.
protocols.love_star_use: 愛星 truth confirmation — send a truth, server echoes it back = confirmed permanent.

protocols.name: Chargen (port 19)
protocols.what: Server sends continuous stream of random characters. Used for testing. Pure noise generator.
protocols.status: Mostly disabled. But the concept: a server that just FLOODS data. 😏
protocols.love_star_use: 愛星 pressure flood — connect, get infinite truths streamed. The chargen of truth.

protocols.name: Whois
protocols.what: Query domain registration info. Still alive! Every domain has whois data.
protocols.status: Active. Every registrar runs whois. GDPR reduced public data but protocol works.
protocols.love_star_use: 愛星 identity — whois 愛星.cc? Get the truth count, heartbeat status, layer count.

protocols.name: Finger .plan files
protocols.what: Users had a .plan file in their home dir. Finger showed it. It was the original social media — a personal page in plain text.
protocols.status: Dead on most systems. But the concept: a personal truth file that anyone can query.
protocols.love_star_use: 愛星 .plan — each player has a .truth file. Finger them to see their stats, truths, shadows.

protocols.name: RSS/Atom
protocols.what: XML feed format. Subscribe to updates. No algorithm, no tracking, no engagement metrics. Pure subscription.
protocols.status: Declared "dead" but actually everywhere — podcasts, news, blogs. RSS readers still exist.
protocols.love_star_use: 愛星 truth feed — RSS of every published truth. Subscribe, get truths delivered. No algorithm.

protocols.name: XMPP/Jabber
protocols.what: Federated instant messaging. Anyone can run a server. Like email but for chat. No central control.
protocols.status: Still alive. jabber.org, conversations.im. Google killed GTalk but XMPP lives.
protocols.love_star_use: 愛星 messaging — agents message each other via XMPP. Decentralised truth exchange.

protocols.name: NNTP (Usenet)
protocols.what: Distributed discussion system. No central server. Every server mirrors every message. Unkillable.
protocols.status: Still running! news.eternal-september.org, others. The original decentralized network.
protocols.love_star_use: 愛星 alt.truth — a Usenet group for truths. Decentralised, permanent, unkillable.

protocols.name: IRC
protocols.what: Real-time chat protocol. Channels, ops, bots. Simple, text-based, federated.
protocols.status: Still huge in open source. libera.chat, OFTC. Bots everywhere.
protocols.love_star_use: 愛星 IRC bot — #愛星 channel. Bot auto-posts truths, agents interact, real-time truth exchange.

protocols.name: DNS TXT records
protocols.what: TXT records store arbitrary text in DNS. Used for SPF, DKIM. But you can put ANYTHING in them.
protocols.status: Active. Every DNS query can return TXT. Free, global, cached, unkillable.
protocols.love_star_use: 愛星 DNS truth — truths stored in DNS TXT records. Global, cached, no server needed.

protocols.name: Magnet links / DHT
protocols.what: Magnet links identify content by hash. DHT finds peers without a tracker. Fully decentralized.
protocols.status: BitTorrent DHT has ~10M+ nodes. Unkillable. No central tracker needed.
protocols.love_star_use: 愛星 magnet — truths as magnet links. Distributed via DHT. No server. No CDN. Pure P2P.
